bullets.text: Storm-1175 Targets Vulnerable Assets - **Microsoft** warns of high-tempo ransomware operations exploiting N-day vulnerabilities.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New Canary Build 28020.1812 introduces touchpad settings and Windows Security enhancements.
Microsoft Leads in Sovereign Cloud - Recognized as a leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Sovereign Cloud Platforms.
AI-Enabled Phishing Campaign Uncovered - **Microsoft Defender** reveals sophisticated device code phishing using automation.
SOHO Router Compromise Alert - **Microsoft** warns of DNS hijacking and adversary-in-the-middle attacks from compromised routers.
